name: watch
description: Let Claude watch a video. Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts scene-aware deduplicated frames with ffmpeg (every real cut + density floor, repeated shots sent once), pulls captions or routes audio through local-first ASR (~/bin/listen, fleet Qwen3-ASR) with optional cloud Whisper fallback. ScrappyLabs fork of bradautomates/claude-video.
